[用户追问]
请用一句话说明背景上下文主要在讨论什么，并确认你看到了选中段落。

[来源说明]
这是从主线程派生的独立支线。请围绕当前选中段落回答，不要调用任何工具。

availableCommands.name: compact
availableCommands.description: Compact the conversation context

availableCommands.name: status
availableCommands.description: Show current session status

availableCommands.name: usage
availableCommands.description: Show session token usage

availableCommands.name: mcp
availableCommands.description: Show MCP server status

availableCommands.name: tasks
availableCommands.description: List background tasks

availableCommands.name: help
availableCommands.description: Show available ACP commands

availableCommands.name: check-kimi-code-docs
availableCommands.description: Answer questions about the Kimi Code product using the official documentation — CLI usage, configuration, slash commands, features, membership and quota, API onboarding, third-party tool setup, and error codes. Use when the user asks how Kimi Code works, how to set something up, or what a Kimi Code error message means.

availableCommands.name: custom-theme
availableCommands.description: Create or edit a kimi-code custom color theme — a JSON file under the resolved KIMI_CODE_HOME data directory that recolors the TUI. Use when the user wants their own theme, asks for a specific palette or mood, or wants to tweak an existing custom theme's colors.

availableCommands.name: import-from-cc-codex
availableCommands.description: Import Claude Code and Codex instructions, skills, and MCP settings into Kimi Code.

availableCommands.name: mcp-config
availableCommands.description: Configure MCP servers and handle MCP OAuth login.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill
availableCommands.description: Discover and reorganize the skill inventory into hierarchical sub-skill bundles. Use when the user asks to review, group, or consolidate skills into a parent bundle.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill.consolidate
availableCommands.description: Apply an approved sub-skill grouping by moving user-specified skills into a parent bundle, with timestamped backups of every modified directory.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill.review
availableCommands.description: Analyze the available skill set and recommend candidate groups that could be consolidated into sub-skill bundles. Read-only — proposes a plan, does not move files.

availableCommands.name: update-config
availableCommands.description: Inspect or edit kimi-code's own config — `config.toml` (model, provider, permission, hooks) and `tui.toml` (theme, editor, notifications, auto-update). Use when the user asks what a setting does or wants to change one.

availableCommands.name: write-goal
availableCommands.description: Help the user craft a well-specified `/goal` objective for goal mode — turn a rough intention into a completion contract with a clear finish line, proof, boundaries, and stop rule. Use when the user asks for help writing, refining, or improving a goal.

availableCommands.description: Compact the conversation context

availableCommands.description: Show current session status

availableCommands.name: usage
availableCommands.description: Show session token usage

availableCommands.name: mcp
availableCommands.description: Show MCP server status

availableCommands.name: tasks
availableCommands.description: List background tasks

availableCommands.name: help
availableCommands.description: Show available ACP commands

availableCommands.name: check-kimi-code-docs
availableCommands.description: Answer questions about the Kimi Code product using the official documentation — CLI usage, configuration, slash commands, features, membership and quota, API onboarding, third-party tool setup, and error codes. Use when the user asks how Kimi Code works, how to set something up, or what a Kimi Code error message means.

availableCommands.name: custom-theme
availableCommands.description: Create or edit a kimi-code custom color theme — a JSON file under the resolved KIMI_CODE_HOME data directory that recolors the TUI. Use when the user wants their own theme, asks for a specific palette or mood, or wants to tweak an existing custom theme's colors.

availableCommands.name: import-from-cc-codex
availableCommands.description: Import Claude Code and Codex instructions, skills, and MCP settings into Kimi Code.

availableCommands.name: mcp-config
availableCommands.description: Configure MCP servers and handle MCP OAuth login.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill
availableCommands.description: Discover and reorganize the skill inventory into hierarchical sub-skill bundles. Use when the user asks to review, group, or consolidate skills into a parent bundle.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill.consolidate
availableCommands.description: Apply an approved sub-skill grouping by moving user-specified skills into a parent bundle, with timestamped backups of every modified directory.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill.review
availableCommands.description: Analyze the available skill set and recommend candidate groups that could be consolidated into sub-skill bundles. Read-only — proposes a plan, does not move files.

availableCommands.name: update-config
availableCommands.description: Inspect or edit kimi-code's own config — `config.toml` (model, provider, permission, hooks) and `tui.toml` (theme, editor, notifications, auto-update). Use when the user asks what a setting does or wants to change one.

availableCommands.name: write-goal
availableCommands.description: Help the user craft a well-specified `/goal` objective for goal mode — turn a rough intention into a completion contract with a clear finish line, proof, boundaries, and stop rule. Use when the user asks for help writing, refining, or improving a goal.

options.name: Auto
options.description: Fully autonomous — agent decides everything without asking.

options.name: YOLO
options.description: Auto-approve tool actions, but the agent may still ask questions.

availableCommands.name: check-kimi-code-docs
availableCommands.description: Answer questions about the Kimi Code product using the official documentation — CLI usage, configuration, slash commands, features, membership and quota, API onboarding, third-party tool setup, and error codes. Use when the user asks how Kimi Code works, how to set something up, or what a Kimi Code error message means.

availableCommands.name: custom-theme
availableCommands.description: Create or edit a kimi-code custom color theme — a JSON file under the resolved KIMI_CODE_HOME data directory that recolors the TUI. Use when the user wants their own theme, asks for a specific palette or mood, or wants to tweak an existing custom theme's colors.

availableCommands.name: import-from-cc-codex
availableCommands.description: Import Claude Code and Codex instructions, skills, and MCP settings into Kimi Code.

availableCommands.name: mcp-config
availableCommands.description: Configure MCP servers and handle MCP OAuth login.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill
availableCommands.description: Discover and reorganize the skill inventory into hierarchical sub-skill bundles. Use when the user asks to review, group, or consolidate skills into a parent bundle.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill.consolidate
availableCommands.description: Apply an approved sub-skill grouping by moving user-specified skills into a parent bundle, with timestamped backups of every modified directory.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill.review
availableCommands.description: Analyze the available skill set and recommend candidate groups that could be consolidated into sub-skill bundles. Read-only — proposes a plan, does not move files.

availableCommands.name: update-config
availableCommands.description: Inspect or edit kimi-code's own config — `config.toml` (model, provider, permission, hooks) and `tui.toml` (theme, editor, notifications, auto-update). Use when the user asks what a setting does or wants to change one.

availableCommands.name: write-goal
availableCommands.description: Help the user craft a well-specified `/goal` objective for goal mode — turn a rough intention into a completion contract with a clear finish line, proof, boundaries, and stop rule. Use when the user asks for help writing, refining, or improving a goal.
